div.div: مِدْعَكٌ : see the following paragraph. [For أَلَدُّ in the K, Golius seems to have found in his copy of that Lexicon آلَةُ; for he has explained مِدْعَكٌ, as on the authority of the K, by “ Instrumentum quo quid defricatur aut levigatur; ” a meaning which it may possibly have, as agreeable with analogy, but for which I find no authority.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
